description: Edit the tracked prompts for a brand: the buyer questions the seven engines are asked every day. Add, remove, enable or disable them by exact text, or replace the whole set. Prompts are what the product actually measures, so this decides what the daily spend buys — a prompt no buyer types is a wasted engine check, and a prompt whose premise is false ("is X the cheapest") gets answered NO and scores as a citation anyway. Reads the current set first and returns a before/after diff, so an add never silently drops the prompts you did not mention. DESTRUCTIVE: `remove` deletes a prompt and `replace` overwrites the entire set, and a deleted prompt loses its place in the daily grid along with its history. Prefer `disable` when the goal is to stop spending on a prompt. WRITE ACTION — requires a Pro plan or higher; on Starter/trial the MCP is read-only.

add.description: Prompt texts to add. Existing prompts are kept. Duplicates (case-insensitive) are ignored rather than doubled.

brand.description: Brand id (from list_brands) OR its bare domain, e.g. 'acme.com'.

disable.description: Prompt texts to stop checking without deleting. This is the reversible way to free pool capacity.

enable.description: Prompt texts to switch back on.

remove.description: Prompt texts to delete outright, matched case-insensitively against the current set. Deleting loses that prompt's future tracking; use `disable` to stop spending on it while keeping it.

replace.description: Replace the ENTIRE prompt set with exactly these. Destructive: every prompt not listed here is deleted, along with its place in the daily grid. Cannot be combined with add/remove/enable/disable. Prefer those unless the user asked for a full rewrite.

name: set_prompts
